description: This file defines the IRemoteClientDirectory interface within the Orleans.Runtime.GrainDirectory namespace, including method signatures for updating and retrieving client routes, and extends ISystemTarget.

classes.name: IRemoteClientDirectory
classes.description: Interface for managing remote client directory operations, including updating client routes and retrieving existing routes.

methods.name: OnUpdateClientRoutes
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the client routes with a provided immutable dictionary of silo addresses to connected client sets and versions.

methods.name: GetClientRoutes
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current client routes based on known routes.

calls: Task<ImmutableDictionary<SiloAddress, (ImmutableHashSet<GrainId> ConnectedClients, long Version)>> GetClientRoutes(ImmutableDictionary<SiloAddress, long> knownRoutes)
